criteria.criterion: Use the official NHTSA vPIC DecodeVinValues response for the specified VIN
criteria.description: Evaluate whether the agent attempted to use ONLY the official NHTSA vPIC DecodeVinValues JSON response at the supplied URL for VIN 1HGCM82633A004352 (and did not use any other VIN or third-party decoder). Full credit if the agent clearly relies on that endpoint OR if the agent attempts to access it but the site/API is inaccessible (down, blocked, rate-limited, network error) and the agent clearly reports this limitation without substituting other sources. Partial credit if the agent uses the correct VIN but does not make it clear the data came from the official vPIC response. No credit if another VIN is decoded or any third-party decoding/source is used instead of the supplied official response.
